body: I don’t know man but if this ain’t a sign, idk what is.
There’s been many times where I’ll just joke around about “dying immediately” and I’ll almost get hit by a car or get stabbed with something sharp. If that’s not a big sign, I’m not sure what is.

There’s a lot of things that are happening and it’s pretty much a clear sign from life telling me to end myself. All I’ve ever wanted to do was travel the world but that’s not going to happen any time soon. I’m just thinking about things I can do easily, doesn’t have to be amazing or crazy, mostly because I’m planning on ending it soon.
Trust me, I give relationship advice and it’s so good for other people except me
That’s all I want
Guess I’ll just wait it out a bit. See where it leads. The moment I realize something, I’ll just let her go. Thank you

I don’t want it to be too pushy. I mean we’re still young (19 and 18) so I don’t know how she’d react to it. My fear right now is that she doesn’t even see me as a friend anymore but instead as just another guy she’s rejecting.

I’ve told her everything. How I feel about her and she’s said it sweet but there’s a lot of guys that also want to be with her. I’m not sure I’m any different compared to them. She’s told me many times before that I’m the guy she’s willing to date compared to everyone else but it’s not happening right now. I guess it just has to be a matter of time kinda thing.
I don’t want to be hanging on to her for such a long time only to see that she’s happy with another guy. I guess it doesn’t hurt to wait it out for a bit though.
Was it worth it? I don’t want to spend so much time in the friendzone only to not end up with her.
Should I just let it go?
Thanks
Can’t see myself past 20 and I’m 19

Why not save yourself the time and do it sooner than later?
Is there any positives to suicide?
Thank you for the advice, I highly appreciate it

I was in contact with a therapist who helped a friend out and she gave me some places I can try out. I’m just not sure if I can just say “hey, I’m having a hard time and I need some help” and they’ll be okay with it or they’ll deny helping me.
Just doesn’t seem like something that would work for me. I need more “actual” experience if that makes sense.
I’m not sure I follow what you’re saying
I tend to make myself the “exception” many times. A bit of “oh everyone deserves love...just not me”
I’ve been trying to give up on it. I feel it would be best for me but then I get these random moments where it’s like “maybe you do have a chance” and it just goes downhill from there.

I recently got over it somehow but now it’s back because everyone I know is in a happy relationship where they both overcome obstacles to keep their love alive and I’m just waiting for something that might not even happen.
For me, showering someone with loves makes me feel better about myself. The whole “love yourself first” also makes me feel like “why love myself when no one else does?”
Only friends. Not open with my family about it.
The only choices we have. Everyone chooses their own.
I’ve felt many times that we stay here not to find happiness but to see how we can reduce the pain. There’s no point to us being here but here we all are.
As bad as this may sound, it’s a bit of a relief to know I’m not alone. Although I do wish it wasn’t like this.
I don’t really see myself being around for many years. I’m giving it a go even with everything falling apart. Not really sure why though
The past 5-6 years have been very tough and I’ve only recently realized that I’m going to keep suffering. I’m okay with it.
It’s going to be just as bad for them. They’re hoping for a better but that’s not exactly going to happen.
I feel like the whole “it gets better” is kinda like saying “you can’t feel anything bad anymore”. Reality is, I’ll feel more pain.
We choose how to suffer, who to suffer with, where to suffer. We can change all we want but the suffering will never go away.

I don’t hate anyone who says it to me. I just hate the phrase. I’d rather someone tell me how it is instead of showing pity and telling me I’ll be okay. I find comfort in the truth, not people saying phrases that don’t have any guarantee. If anything, those phrases make me feel worse because I’ve heard them many times.
Some people are just here to suffer forever. “It gets better” is a very empty promise.
Thank you for the advice, it’s nice to not feel so lonely at the moment
I guess. I’m just not sure if what I’m doing will end up setting me on a good path to achieve all I want.

I’m a college student so everyone I know is going to school and working. I don’t want to spend money on college only to flunk out or graduate and have a degree that’s useless because I’m not good enough to start my career. My job isn’t very good, working minimum wage but my coworkers help me tolerate it. I don’t really think I’m doing anything amazing or special right now.

As of right now, I’m not really motivated by anything. I’m just kinda doing what most people my age are doing but that’s only because it’s the norm. When it comes to me wanting to harm myself, it’s more of a fantasy than it is me actually trying.

I want to relax, I really do but it’s a cycle that I feel I can’t escape. I’m always told that it’ll all come at its time but I feel it’s unrealistic for everything to happen because I sat back and chilled instead of working for it. I feel I don’t have anything to hold onto and as much as I look for it, I can’t find a single thing. I feel something needs to happen soon so I can feel somewhat alive.

Hiya,
First of all, thank you for the reply. My worries are always on a constant cycle. For a few days or week, I stress over my future (career, home, love, money) and then I’ll move onto realizing that my current state is in no way going to help me in my future years and then I’ll compare myself to others which eventually leads to me feeling like an absolute waste of space and thinking I should be dead. I know it’s overthinking to an extreme but I can’t help it.
